India's Emmy Hopes End at 2026 Awards Ceremony

India's participation in the International Emmy Awards 2026 concluded without any wins. The series 'Real Kashmir Football Club', featuring Manav Kaul and Zeeshan Ayub, lost in its category to a French entry. Comedian Vir Das also did not secure an award. Actor Vijay Sethupathi was a presenter at the event.
